create_gaussian_kernel: create a Gaussian kernel numpy array with a specified kernel size and optional standard deviation
build_FCLayer: build a fully connected layer with configurable input output dimensions and optional LeakyReLU activation
use_weight_norm_wrapper: use the weight norm wrapper to create a fused unfusable weight normalized version of any torch module
create_Conv2dUB: create a 2D convolution layer with untied spatial bias parameters instead of a single bias per channel
use_ConcatPyramid: use ConcatPyramid to concatenate a downsampled or upsampled pyramid of a second input at each branch layer
